name: 50 years Hip Hop in The Netherlands - Somebody has to do it
original_name: 50 jaar hiphop in Nederland - Iemand moet het doen
overview: Directors Ivan Barbosa andSacha Vermeulen dive deep in the culture, pain, pride and power of the Dutch Hip Hop scene. With honest stories and a sharp observation, the series shows that Hip Hop is more than music - It's a way of life, an attitude, a philosophy.
